name: One failure with an obvious root cause
description: Temperature conversion formula subtracts 32 instead of adding 32.
golden_patch:
--- a/converter.py
+++ b/converter.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def celsius_to_fahrenheit(celsius: float) -> float:
     # BUG: subtracted offset instead of adding
-    return (celsius * 9.0 / 5.0) - 32.0
+    return (celsius * 9.0 / 5.0) + 32.0

candidate_hypotheses.root_cause_statement: Inverted offset sign in celsius_to_fahrenheit formula.
candidate_hypotheses.causal_explanation: Subtracting 32 instead of adding produces inverted offset.

missing_evidence_or_assumptions: Does not explain why 0 celsius produces -32 instead of 0.
